item.title: HTB - Access
item.description: Access is an easy difficulty machine, that highlights how machines associated with the physical security of an environment may not themselves be secure. Also highlighted is how accessible FTP/file shares can often lead to getting a foothold or lateral movement. It teaches techniques for identifying and exploiting saved credentials.

item.title: HTB - Active
item.description: Active is an easy to medium difficulty machine, which features two very prevalent techniques to gain privileges within an Active Directory environment.
